commit.message:
R50: difficulty escalation — a perfect oracle always eventually dies (#68)

Speed law: min((1+frames*ramp)*hitBoost^hits + accel*frames^2, maxSpeedMul);
hitBoost revived (compounds via hits, no more one-frame dead boost);
paddle shrinks shrink^frames floored at paddleMin (one law for draw AND
death-check in L1+C1); decision cadence slows via decisionIntervalAt
(drift 0.05, cap 16, L1 only); swan probability quadratic in speedMul.
Escalation-off = byte-identical to the pre-R50 law (regression lock).

Oracle pin: perfect-intercept oracle dies <3000f on seeds 1..10 with
escalation on, survives 6000f cap with it off — guaranteed eventual
failure => selection rewards predicting the eventual position.

Canonical re-embed: curve f9b20e7d/L0 bc15d414/L1 1125d59c/L2 50137ceb,
coev 946e639a byte-unchanged (inert at coev horizons); maxSpeed 4.443/3.411;
tie journal 182/89 -> 5/3. README artifact line corrected (was pre-R21).
Suite 245/245 + qa 8/8; README count 243->253 (pin-verified).

Co-authored-by: CCC <ccc@fleet.local>
